name: A Dungeon Master's Guide Through the Friendzone
source:
College student and Dungeon Master Dominic finds himself uncharacteristically attracted to his friend group. Can he sort out his feelings? Do his friends feel the same? Oh, and it's also an isekai.

[From [url=https://isekai-akai.itch.io/a-dungeon-masters-guide-through-the-friendzone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大学生兼地下城主多米尼克发现自己异常地被他的朋友团体所吸引。他能理清自己的感情吗？他的朋友们也有同样的感觉吗？哦，这也是异世界。

[来自[url=https://isekai-akai.itch.io/a-dungeon-masters-guide-through-the-friendzone]Itch.io[/url]]
